explication: Kodi is a media player and entertainment hub. Its user-facing loop is to browse or add media, scan it into a personalized library, and play or stream it through the interface; playlists, add-ons, PVR, and weather extend that experience. The README documents these capabilities, while the sampled source index confirms selected application, GUI, playback, settings, and PVR relationships. Several feature paths below are represented at their existing source files, but their internal calls were not sampled, so those documented links cite the README.
